text.text: Check out the [full changelog](https://github.com/JannisX11/blockbench/releases/tag/v5.2.0) - or watch the [update video](https://youtu.be/9MET5-wH5uw)!

features.title: 3D Reference Images
features.text:
Position your reference image as a 3D plane anywhere in your scene!

Also new: Playback controls for video references, locked references in the 2D image editor, and moveable reference models!

features.title: Screen-Space Brush
features.text: Paint from the angle of your view across any edges and elements!

features.title: Layer Groups
features.text: Organize your texture layers with the new layer groups!

features.title: Inverse Kinematics
features.text: IK is now better than ever! Pole vectors give you control over bend directions, armatures are fully supported, and it's faster and smoother!
